In his new memoir, Joe Biden reveals that Trump told him they could have been good friends if they had not been political rivals.
Biden recalls that during their White House meeting following Trump's 2024 election victory, Trump was unexpectedly friendly, leaving Biden surprised and wondering whether he was being sincere.
Trump, according to Biden:
You know, Joe, if it weren’t for politics, I believe we’d be good friends.
If it weren’t for politics, we’d spend all our time golfing together.
Biden also says Trump told him he was relieved not to have faced him in the 2024 presidential election.
According to Biden, Trump's unusually warm behavior left him confused, prompting him to redirect the conversation toward global affairs.
The meeting, originally scheduled for 30 minutes, lasted nearly two hours.
Source: The Atlantic

Finland’s Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen rejected a reported Russian demand that Helsinki leave NATO, calling the suggestion “absolutely outrageous” and “in no way a matter for negotiation.”
“Such matters are in no way a matter for negotiation. Russia knows that. This is absolutely outrageous to even suggest such a thing,” Häkkänen said.

Iraqi Communications Minister Mustafa Jabbar Sanad made off-the-cuff remarks at a public appearance. 
They included a water-bottle mix-up and that he deleted ChatGPT over its military use.
Sanad said bottled water in Iraq was all Saudi seven or eight years ago and "now they are all Iraqi." 
He then picked up the bottle beside him and asked if it was Saudi too. 
The host said it was, and the audience laughed.
He then said that when the Pentagon announced ChatGPT as a replacement for an AI app used in the war, "I deleted it immediately." 
He added that he first confronted the chatbot and asked, "Whatever is going on with you, so you turned out like this?"
His reasoning was that once it "became an enemy" that would use him "as a target," there was no point keeping it on his phone.
